BLT Releases Q1 2025 Financial Report: Revenue Reaches RMB 227 Million, with Continued Emphasis on R&D Investment

, Xi’an Bright Laser Technologies Co., Ltd. (BLT) officially released its financial results for the first quarter of 2025. The report reveals a notable increase in revenue and a significant intensification of investment in research and development, underscoring the company’s steadfast commitment to technological innovation.

The net profit attributable to shareholders of the listed company for this quarter stood at negative RMB 14.95 million, a decline from a profit of RMB 957,500 in the corresponding period of the previous year. According to the report, this downturn in profitability primarily stems from a substantial rise in direct R&D expenditure and increased employee compensation.
